<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD builds and installs the "lito" C++ build tool from the project's own GitHub repositories. All source URLs point to the legitimate upstream `litocpp` organization (lito, rstd, luato, licrypto), and specific tags or pinned commits are used for each source.

No obfuscated code, suspicious network destinations, or unexpected file operations were found. The build process uses CMake with FetchContent pointing to local source directories (FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_*), which is standard practice for offline builds. All four sources have SHA-256 checksums provided (none are SKIP), and the build dependencies (cmake, clang, lld, ninja, llvm, libc++) are appropriate for compiling the project.

The package() function installs files using the standard DESTDIR approach into "$pkgdir", which is conventional Arch Linux packaging behavior. No malicious or unauthorized operations are present.
</details>
<evidence></evidence>
<summary>Standard PKGBUILD building from legitimate upstream sources</summary>
